description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Simple, which facilitates the creation of simple graphs using the Image_Graph library. It includes constructor and factory methods, and references external classes like Image_Graph, Title, dataset, and line_grid.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Simple
classes.description: A class for creating simple graphs, extending the Image_Graph base class. Provides methods for setup and instantiation of graph objects with specific parameters.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Simple
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a simple graph with specified dimensions, plot type, data, title, and optional styling options.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Static method to create and return an instance of Image_Graph_Simple with given parameters.
